basics.name: Galib Hassan Khan
basics.label: PhD Student in Chemical Engineering
basics.summary: PhD student in Chemical Engineering at the University of Tennessee, Knoxville, specializing in metabolic network modeling, machine learning applications in systems biology, and computational approaches to metabolic engineering and modular cell design.

work.name: University of Tennessee, Knoxville
work.summary: Developing computational tools for metabolic network modeling and analysis. Applying machine learning techniques to biological systems. Working on modular cell design and microbial community optimization.

work.name: International Centre for Diarrhoeal Disease Research, Bangladesh (iccdr,b)
work.summary: Worked on environmental health projects focused on air pollution reduction. Analyzed data from brick manufacturing industry to develop pollution mitigation strategies.

work.name: Shikho
work.summary: Continued contributing to educational technology after Bohubrihi acquisition. Developed machine learning models for personalized learning.

work.name: Bohubrihi
work.summary: Co-founded an edtech startup providing professional technical education in Bengali. Led technology development and platform architecture. Successfully exited through acquisition by Shikho in 2021.

education.institution: Bangladesh University of Engineering and Technology (BUET)

publications.name: Smart culture medium optimization for recombinant protein production: Experimental, modeling, and AI/ML-driven strategies
publications.summary: This comprehensive review explores the integration of experimental approaches, mathematical modeling, and artificial intelligence/machine learning strategies for optimizing culture medium in recombinant protein production.

publications.name: A Multi-Objective Optimization Framework for Scalable Biomanufacturing through Modular Cell Design and Resource Allocation
publications.summary: A novel multi-objective optimization framework for scalable biomanufacturing that leverages modular cell design principles and optimal resource allocation strategies.

publications.name: Room Occupancy Detection from Temperature, Light, Humidity, and Carbon Dioxide Measurements Using Deep Learning
publications.publisher: 2021 International Conference on Computer, Communication, Chemical, Materials and Electronic Engineering (IC4ME2)
publications.summary: A deep learning approach for room occupancy detection using environmental sensor data including temperature, light, humidity, and carbon dioxide measurements.

publications.name: Modeling Thermodynamic and Kinetic Simulation of Hydrogen Production from Dry Reforming of Natural Gas
publications.publisher: 2021 International Conference on Computer, Communication, Chemical, Materials and Electronic Engineering (IC4ME2)
publications.summary: Thermodynamic and kinetic modeling of hydrogen production through dry reforming of natural gas, investigating reaction mechanisms and optimization strategies.
